title: Something, something, sarcasm, ahah.

themes.title: Champion balance
themes.description: 5 champion buffs, 7 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: Something, something, sarcasm, ahah. Structured changes across 20 entities this patch.
